analysis_type: fresh model static annual downside analysis using existing pure calculation functions; no provider/runtime execution

accepted_handoffs.contribution: FY2024 numerical operands and definitions, sources and limitations
context: demand channels, margins/cash conversion, documented distribution behavior, critical current liquidity/legal gaps
risk synthesis: aviation demand/cost pressure combined with debt service, shareholder extraction and FY2028-29 refinancing dependence

ebitda.meaning: issuer EBITDA As Defined, total company; non-GAAP; not ordinary EBITDA or operating cash

interest.meaning: positive magnitude of annual cash interest paid
interest.source: CP-1 T4.5 supplemental cash paid during period for interest, net, FY2024, PDF 109

fcf.meaning: calculated operating cash less capex proxy (2045 - 165); not issuer-defined FCF
fcf.source: CP-1 T4.10; CP-1 T4.5 and CP-1-attempt-2-calculations.txt

total_debt.meaning: carrying-value classification sum including separate securitization (24296 + 98 + 486); not gross principal
total_debt.source: CP-1 T4.10/T4.6; long-term debt + current portion + separate securitization, PDF 105

cash.meaning: reported closing cash; unrestricted availability not established

reported_ratios.meaning: CP-1 accepted handoff supplies no reported total leverage, net leverage, interest coverage or FCF/debt ratio for reconciliation; calculated ratios below do not fill this gap

scenarios.name: Base (no stress)
scenarios.assumption: zero-shock control; validates formulas against supplied base

scenarios.name: Demand and margin pressure
scenarios.rationale: CP-2 identifies lower aircraft utilization, airline/OEM weakness and potentially delayed defense demand; if costs do not flex/pass through, margin and cash generation could weaken. The size is illustrative, not calibrated.

scenarios.name: Demand, margin and interest pressure
scenarios.assumption: hypothetical 20% EBITDA As Defined decline plus 10% cash-interest increase
scenarios.rationale: combines the CP-2 demand/cost pathway with its debt-service/refinancing dependence pathway; interest increase is an analyst overlay, not a forecast or probability.

watch_levels.label: 7.0x total carrying-debt / EBITDA watch
watch_levels.assumption: analyst watch level; not issuer-reported, covenant or default limit

watch_levels.label: 3.0x EBITDA / cash-interest watch
watch_levels.assumption: analyst watch level; not issuer-reported, covenant or default limit

confidence: Medium, below High; hypothetical shocks and missing forward operating/liquidity/covenant evidence preclude stronger confidence
scope_limits: debt and cash fixed at September 30, 2024 closing balances
no tax shield, working-capital or capex response
no liquidity/runway, covenant headroom, funding/refinancing execution or recovery analysis
CP-2B event-risk/catalyst calendar duties T5.1-T5.7 are not covered
